description:
Check the status and progress of a batch verification job.

Args:
  - job_id (string): The job ID from deliveriq_batch_verify

Returns:
  Job status, progress percentage, and summary when complete.

Examples:
  - "Check job abc123" -> { job_id: "abc123" }

Credit cost: Free

job_id.description: Batch job ID returned by deliveriq_batch_verify

name: deliveriq_batch_status
title: Check Batch Job Status
